test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A journey undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose, especially that of exploration or research.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Expedition'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Voyage - **a long journey involving travel by sea or in space. - *His **voyage **to America was long. *
 
• **Expedition - **a journey undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose, especially that of exploration, research, or war. - *He was on an **expedition **to explore the Antarctic. *
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that **expedition **is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 

Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Voyage (यात्रा) **- a long journey involving travel by sea or in space.

 
 
• **Example**: Their voyage across the Atlantic Ocean took over a month.
 
 
 
• **Expedition (अभियान) **- a journey undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose, especially that of exploration, research, or war.
 
 
• **Example:** The expedition to the South Pole was challenging but ultimately successful.
 
 
 
• **Sojourn (ठहराव)** - a temporary stay at a place.
 
 
• **Example: **During our trip, we had a brief sojourn in a quaint village in the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Pilgrimage (तीर्थयात्रा)** - a journey to a sacred place or shrine of importance to a person's beliefs and faith.
 
 
• **Example**: Every year, thousands make a pilgrimage to the holy city of Varanasi.
